# Modern Wiremock Best Practices Plugin ### Deterministic Service Virtualization, API Mocking & Fault Injection [![Antigravity Plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/Antigravity-Plugin%20v1.0.0-4F46E5.svg)](https://antigravity.google) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-10B981.svg)](./LICENSE) [![Website](https://img.shields.io/badge/Website-halcyontech.com.br-008080.svg)](https://www.halcyontech.com.br/) [![Organization](https://img.shields.io/badge/Organization-HalcyonTech--LTDA-black.svg)](https://github.com/HalcyonTech-LTDA)

Professional modern WireMock best practices covering declarative stubs architecture (mappings/ and __files/), response payload separation, Handlebars dynamic templating, stateful scenarios, fault injection, container orchestration, and mandatory living README.md documentation discipline.

--- ## Installation & Verification ### Antigravity CLI (`agy`) Install directly into your Antigravity environment via the CLI: ```bash agy plugin install https://github.com/HalcyonTech-LTDA/modern-wiremock-best-practices ``` Verify that the plugin is active and adheres to the strict official schema: ```bash agy plugin list agy plugin validate --strict ./modern-wiremock-best-practices ``` --- ## Overview In modern distributed microservices and cloud architectures, external dependencies (third-party payment gateways, identity providers, credit bureaus, partner APIs) present significant testing hurdles: network flakiness, rate limits, non-deterministic sandbox data, and financial costs. WireMock is the industry-standard tool for simulating HTTP APIs. However, mock implementations frequently deteriorate into unmaintainable anti-patterns: - Monolithic, 500-line JSON stub mappings with giant inlined response payloads. - Proliferation of dozens of nearly identical static stub files differing only by an ID. - Silent divergence between real upstream contracts and mock server implementations. - "Black-box" mock directories that developers cannot run, verify, or understand without digging through hundreds of JSON files. This plugin establishes modern, production-grade engineering standards for WireMock across three fundamental pillars: 1. **Declarative Stub Architecture & Payload Decoupling**: Enforcing strict separation between HTTP matching/routing rules in `mappings/` and externalized response payloads in `__files/`, leveraging Handlebars response templating to eliminate stub bloat. 2. **Mandatory Living Documentation**: Requiring every mock server to maintain an up-to-date, comprehensive `README.md` acting as a living contract catalog with a structured **Scenario Matrix**, local execution recipes, and copy-pasteable `curl` smoke tests. 3. **Container Orchestration & Resilient Testing**: Standardizing official `wiremock/wiremock:3.x` container builds, Docker Compose healthcheck choreography against `/__admin/health`, Testcontainers integration, and zero-PII security hygiene. --- --- ## What's Included (Component Catalog) ### Contextual Rules (`rules/`) Automatically loaded to govern and protect project contexts: - **[`modern-wiremock-engineering.md`](rules/modern-wiremock-engineering.md)**: >- ### Procedural Skills (`skills/`) On-demand actionable workflows and runbooks: - **[`/modern-wiremock-declarative-stubs`](skills/modern-wiremock-declarative-stubs/SKILL.md)**: Use this skill when authoring, reviewing, or refactoring WireMock declarative stubs (mappings/) and external response payloads (__files/): request matching criteria, bodyFileName decoupling, Handlebars response templating, priority choreography, stateful scenarios, and fault injection. - **[`/modern-wiremock-living-documentation`](skills/modern-wiremock-living-documentation/SKILL.md)**: Use this skill when authoring, updating, or reviewing documentation for WireMock mock servers: establishing the mandatory dedicated README.md living documentation, building contract scenario matrices, providing copy-pasteable curl verification recipes, and enforcing documentation synchronization in pull requests. - **[`/modern-wiremock-orchestration-and-testing`](skills/modern-wiremock-orchestration-and-testing/SKILL.md)**: Use this skill when deploying, orchestrating, or testing WireMock in Docker, Docker Compose, CI/CD pipelines, and automated test suites: standalone container hardening, healthcheck choreography (/__admin/health), Testcontainers integration, high-load performance tuning, and zero-PII security hygiene. --- ## Directory Hierarchy ```text modern-wiremock-best-practices/ ├── plugin.json # Official Antigravity manifest (schema v1) ├── LICENSE # MIT License (Copyright 2026 HalcyonTech LTDA) ├── .gitignore # System ignores & installed_version.json exclusions ├── .gitattributes # Deterministic line endings (* text=auto eol=lf) ├── README.md # Golden Standard documentation & runbook ├── assets/ │ ├── logo.svg # Antigravity marketplace square icon │ └── halcyon-horizontal-cor.svg # Official Halcyon Tech brand logo (white background) # Official Halcyon Tech corporate vector symbol ├── rules/ # Contextual rules discovered automatically │ └── modern-wiremock-engineering.md ├── skills/ # Actionable procedural skills (Progressive Disclosure) │ └── modern-wiremock-declarative-stubs/ │ └── SKILL.md │ └── modern-wiremock-living-documentation/ │ └── SKILL.md │ └── modern-wiremock-orchestration-and-testing/ │ └── SKILL.md ``` --- ## 💡 Prompt Recipes & Use Cases ```markdown - "Create deterministic WireMock stubs and dynamic response transformers" - "Configure WireMock standalone or Testcontainers integration for consumer tests" - "Simulate network faults, rate limits, and slow responses with WireMock" ``` --- ## 📄 License & Corporate Governance Distributed under the **MIT License**.
